responsibility: This module is GCC’s target backend for the Andes NDS32 architecture, covering the machine-specific code-generation, ABI, and scheduling logic that turns GCC’s generic RTL into NDS32 assembly for both bare-metal ELF and Linux environments. Its core target files define register, calling-convention, stack, addressing, PIC/TLS, section, asm-output, and option policies; the main machine descriptions and helper predicate/constraint/iterator files describe the baseline instruction set and operand legality; specialized .md and companion source files handle doubleword moves, floating-point and DSP extensions, builtins/intrinsics, load/store-multiple and bulk memory operations, interrupt/exception handler attributes and vector emission, and late peephole or linker-relaxation/fp-as-gp target passes. The module also contains per-core pipeline models and scheduling helpers for multiple NDS32 microarchitectures, plus public target headers and startup support, making it the complete architecture-specific backend that distinguishes NDS32 instruction selection, optimization cost modeling, microarchitectural tuning, and runtime/ABI integration from neighboring GCC target directories.
